title: Deferred shadow rehearsal with snapshot checkpoint and autobackout
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds deferred shadow rehearsal support: snapshot checkpointing for replayable shadow runs, resumable rehearsal jobs, telemetry-driven autobackout policy, and console controls. Backwards compatible; operators can opt-in per rollout. Includes tests and playbook for ops remediation.
description: Motivation: model rollouts that use shadow traffic frequently surface regressions only after long-tail stateful interactions. This PR introduces a deferred shadow rehearsal mode that captures a compact session snapshot at the moment a request enters shadowing, replays that snapshot into an isolated rehearsal runtime on a scheduled or on-demand basis, and provides an autobackout policy driven by telemetry gates. Design: 1) snapshot checkpointing: lightweight session envelope recorded to the rehearsal store (user hints, prefix tokens, KV meta pointers). 2) resumable rehearsals: rehearsal runner persists progress checkpoints so interrupted rehearsals resume from the last step. 3) telemetry gates + autobackout: rehearsal emits the same metric set as production; if configured SLOs or delta thresholds breach, the rollout orchestration can mark a backout candidate and optionally trigger an automated backout with an audit log. 4) orchestration integration: rollout controller supports deferred shadow schedules (cron/on-demand), rehearsal lifecycle, and fine-grained opt-in at cohort level. Implementation summary: - rollout/controller.go: new RehearsalManager and RehearsalLifecycle state machine (persisted to rollout-store) - rehearsal/runner.py: replay engine with checkpoint resume APIs and KVS pointer resolution - telemetry/gates.go + metrics schemas: added rehearsal tags and delta computation helpers - console/ui/rollouts.tsx: UI controls to schedule deferred rehearsals, view snapshots, and trigger autobackout - k8s/manifests/rehearsal-crd.yaml: CRD to represent a RehearsalJob for private deployments - tests/rehearsal_test.go and tests/replay_integration.py: unit + sim tests - docs/playbooks/deferred-shadow-rehearsal.md: operator playbook and migration notes Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged; deferred rehearsals are opt-in for rollout configs. Security/PII: snapshots intentionally avoid storing raw user PII; snapshot schema and encryption notes are documented. Migration: small DB migration to add rehearsal_state to rollout records (non-blocking, migrates lazily). Rollout plan: feature-flag rollout to internal canaries for 2 weeks, run synthetic rehearsals, enable autobackout only in manual mode initially, then opt-in auto mode for low-risk customers. Test plan: unit tests included, simulation harness replay for 10k synthetic sessions, staging soak with A/B cohort for 72h, perf benchmark to exercise rehearsal runner throughput and storage cost. Known limitations: very large long-running sessions will sample prefix only; KV-heavy sessions require additional pointer resolution which is guarded by quota. Motivation links: ENG-2145 describes long-tail regression incidents; SUP-7842 customer report requesting replayable shadow confirmation. This PR is intended to reduce time-to-detect and enable deterministic repro of shadow-induced regressions.
